tagline: Istanbul's most liveable European district — clean, modern, walkable, with a beautiful seafront, excellent transport links, and a strong local community.

items.name: Özgür Kahve
items.description: A beloved neighbourhood café that's been a Bakırköy institution for years. Good Turkish coffee and a loyal local crowd.

items.name: Sahil Café (Florya)
items.description: Beachfront café in nearby Florya with sea views. Perfect for a morning coffee with a completely different Istanbul perspective.

items.name: Bakırköy Balık Hali
items.description: The neighbourhood fish market with fresh catches daily and excellent adjacent restaurants. Very local, very good.
items.tip: Buy fresh fish from the market and have the adjacent restaurants cook it for a small fee — a classic Istanbul experience.

items.name: Cumhuriyet Meydanı Restoranları
items.description: The restaurants around Bakırköy's main square offer a range of good Turkish cuisine at reasonable prices. Very local crowd.

items.name: Florya Sosyal Tesisleri
items.description: The seaside facilities complex in Florya with restaurants and cafés right on the Sea of Marmara. Excellent for a long lunch.

items.name: Sahil (Atatürk Ormanı Coastline)
items.description: A beautiful, long seafront promenade along the Sea of Marmara. Perfect for cycling, running, or evening walks. Very well maintained.

items.name: Özgürlük Parkı
items.description: A large central park in Bakırköy with walking paths, cafés, and a small lake. One of the best urban parks on the European side.

items.name: Bakırköy Shopping (İstanbul Marmara)
items.description: Multiple shopping centres and a good pedestrianised commercial street in the town centre.

tips: Bakırköy is on the M1A metro line and the Marmaray — well connected to the rest of the city.
The coastal walk between Bakırköy and Florya is one of the city's most underrated urban experiences.
It's a genuinely residential neighbourhood — good for understanding how most Istanbulites actually live.
Far fewer tourists than central areas. Prices for food and services are noticeably lower.
